summary: Fetch one or more public still-image origins, normalize each to the rank cell geometry, and compose them into one tile with its drawn-cell proof.

parity.note: This is the fused transport form of media.fetch -> media.filmstrip -> media.sheet. Each origin is streamed once, passed through the same filmstrip argv and the same sheet compositor as the former chain, so the output pixels and drawn-cell sidecar are unchanged; only intermediate files, scheduler steps and durable PUTs disappear. Origins are independent and may fail per cell: a failed URL leaves its cell empty while sibling cells and the sheet still land. The URLs are credential-free public locations checked on every redirect by media.fetch.

urls.description: Credential-free still-image origins. Order is already chosen by the caller and is preserved in the cells.

fit.description: The same cell geometry enum accepted by media.filmstrip.
